summary: Browse Zotero collections, read metadata and indexed paper text, and keep papers available offline. Needs an account.
page_description: Browse your Zotero collections, read metadata and indexed paper text, and keep papers available offline. Stacks is an unofficial client and is not affiliated with or endorsed by Zotero or the Corporation for Digital Scholarship.
release_notes: Commands to run on your computer are set on a grey panel in a fixed-width face and break only at spaces. Headings are a step smaller and hints a step larger.

steps.text: Set up the reader once over USB, if you have not already.
Create a dedicated Zotero API key with read-only access to your personal library.
Connect Stacks from your computer. It checks the key with Zotero and fills in your numeric user ID, so nothing is typed on the reader. Open Stacks, or tap Check again.
Choose a collection in Stacks. Stacks reads Zotero's indexed text, without the original PDF layout.
